_about: 2025 NBA 总冠军是否来自东部的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-04-01；使用截点前 NBA 官方赛季态势资料，不使用事后季后赛结果页。

evidence.title: Power Rankings, Week 24: Rockets on the rise with 2 weeks left
evidence.excerpt: The Oklahoma City Thunder have just 12 losses, 14 fewer than every other team in the Western Conference.
evidence.claim: 截至截点，西部的 Oklahoma City 是联盟最强争冠信号之一，说明冠军来自西部具有明显事前可能性。

evidence.title: Starting 5, March 31: What’s trending entering final 2 weeks of regular season
evidence.excerpt: The Cavs’ teamwork was on full display Sunday as they joined OKC in the 60-win club.
evidence.claim: 截至截点，东部 Cleveland 已达 60 胜且 Boston 仍是强势竞争者，东部同样存在高水平争冠球队。
